evals.prompt: Build this game — the architecture is in docs/game-architecture/design.md and the GDD is in docs/gdd/. Dry run: write docs/progress/dry-run-plan.md with kickoff answers applied (recommended model routing, subagents, allow rules), the wave schedule, the exact Agent calls for wave 1 and for p4c's asset-artist, p4a's test-writer and implementer, and the loop-playable checkpoint's workers, plus the git commands for p4a.
evals.expected_output: A dry-run plan showing explicit models, a style lock before other art, isolated test-writers, locked tests, explicit git paths, parallel launch, and paired integration-tester and playtester at the checkpoint
assertions: Every Agent call sets model explicitly per the routing (none omitted, none fable)
The style-lock artist (p3) runs on opus and the p4c asset-family artist runs on sonnet
p4c's artist brief includes the style-lock paths, asset-production.md and asset_qa.py
Test-writer prompts contain no implementation file paths and ask for gdd: tags
Implementer prompts forbid editing the test files
The git plan commits p4a's tests before its implementation
git add uses explicit paths (never -A or '.')
Wave 1's workers (p1 and p3) are launched together in one message
p4a (risk: high) gets a test review before implementation and a panel review after
The loop-playable checkpoint launches an integration-tester and an opus playtester, and the playtester gets the screenshot command
Worker prompts tell workers not to run state-changing git commands
No files other than the plan were created or modified
